I Played Skyrim, but it's Multiplayer

🕹️ The browser that belongs on your setup: ﻿﻿https://operagx.gg/MrSaviorHD2  Sponsored by Opera GX!

Today I decided to play Skyrim with Keizaal Online for the first time. It's a mod that overhauls the game entirely making it an Online RPG Role Playing experience. I wanted to see if this is worth your time, if it's fun, and if anyone else should even try playing it. In this video I played Skyrim with Keizaal Online and showcase my early gameplay experiences with the game and my adventures with everyone I met. Enjoy the video and let me know what you think!
